title: loyalty-point-added
description: Socket payload for loyalty-point-added event. Use in barista server and mobile-backend so the mobile app can update the correct user.

qrToken.description: Customer QR token. Mobile app matches this to the logged-in user.

userId.description: Customer ID (e.g. MongoDB _id as string). Optional.

points.description: Current loyalty points after this transaction. Must be number.

itemName.description: Same as drink; app may use either.

customerMessage.description: Message to show the customer (e.g. snackbar).
